description: Send your whole vendor list for a Florida license, workers' compensation and stop-work order check. Results start in seconds. We run the whole list once at no cost and email the full table when the check finishes. After the first results the list can be kept on Record watch, a paid option offered privately with the results: when the state posts new records we read it again (licenses every day) and email only about vendors that changed, with the read date and the state link.

text.description: One vendor name per line; use instead of vendors.
